name: Borj Al Burullous

queries.query: Borj Al Burullous Egypt official cadastral map parcel registry Kafr El Sheikh General Authority for Survey
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Egyptian General Authority for Survey (ESA) as the national survey/cadastral custodian and the official Kafr El Sheikh governorate ArcGIS portal as a local spatial-service route. The public service metadata found was administrative/spatial rather than a parcel layer.

queries.result: Arabic discovery confirmed the official ESA describes cadastral/title-record and map services, and the Kafr El Sheikh portal's official legend names برج البرلس. It did not expose an anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response.

registryCustodian.name: Egyptian General Authority for Survey (ESA), with Kafr El Sheikh Governorate spatial-services portal
registryCustodian.scope: ESA is the national survey/cadastral and map custodian; the Kafr El Sheikh portal is a local government spatial map route naming Borj Al Burullous.
registryCustodian.evidence: ESA first-party pages describe cadastral/title-record, digital-map, paper-map, and urban cadastre projects. The Kafr El Sheikh ArcGIS legend and hosted administrative layer explicitly include برج البرلس. This does not establish public parcel-vector coverage.
